close_reason: Fixed: MAINTENANCE comments added; Message/get now respects RFC 8620 §5.1 properties parameter
description:
The ReadDisposition enum (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs:32-53) lacks a MAINTENANCE comment documenting where to add new variants when the spec evolves.

Pattern to follow: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs lines 214-218.

Without this comment, future maintainers may:
- Add a variant to the enum but forget impl_string_enum! mappings
- Not realize this affects serialize/deserialize round-tripping
- Leave the code in a compiling but broken state

Issue: JMAP ChatMessage spec allows servers to receive unknown readDisposition values (§1029: 'unrecognized values are stored as-is'). When new official values are added, maintainers need clear guidance on where to update both the enum AND its serialization macro.
title: ReadDisposition enum needs MAINTENANCE comment for variant extensibility
